messages.subject: Post-stratification and SE
parts:
Dear list,

=20
I=B4m trying to calculate density of aquatic birds in rice fields with =
different growing stages (I'll call them "habitats")that where sampled =
with different efforts. There are several questions I am trying to =
solve, however, some of some issues remain unclear to me.

The survey was carried out using point transects of 500 meters between =
points. With an irregular number of points per transect and in some =
cases there are complete points and other are half points (this is =
solved with the point effort at the points). Distances were measures =
using regular intervals of 10 m up to 150 m (grouped data).

1) There are only 8 species with more than 30 observations when pooling =
the data for two countries. It is right to estimate de density for =
different two countries post- stratifying by habitat? or should I ignore =
different habitats?

2) Depending on the number of observations I pre and post stratify by =
habitat to estimate aviand density on each habitat (stratum). The =
problem is in obtaining the Standard Error for pooled densities (for the =
previous issue). I've been searching for this issue in the mail list and =
I read a similar problem with the subject: Estimating SE for pooled =
density estimates , by MILLER Cameron. I've read the answer but it =
remains unclear to me because I ticked the box under "stratum" and =
"global" and the SE for pooled density does not appear.=20
=20
Thank you!

Andrea.
